story.head: Fox’s favorite opponent
paras: The Rangers have won two in a row, the last a 5-1 rout of Vancouver. The Canadiens (12-4-4) lost 4-1 to Colorado on Saturday. Going in, the Habs are second in the Atlantic (tied for sixth in the NHL) and the Rangers third in the Metropolitan (14th).
The Canadiens’ record (.700) is running ahead of what their chances are worth (.552), largely thanks to their goaltending. The Rangers’ record (.595) is about what their chances are worth.

The Canadiens get into more chippy games than almost anyone (2nd) and have had some of the best goaltending in the league (4th), but take more penalties than they draw (31st). As for the Rangers, they lean on their stars as much as almost anyone (2nd lowest), get more of their shots from in close than almost anyone (2nd) and get a lot of their shots blocked (32nd). The Rangers could find some good looks against the Canadiens, who give up plenty of them.

Cole Caufield (12 G / 7 A / 19 P in 20 GP) leads the Canadiens in scoring, with a point in five straight games against the Rangers. Lane Hutson (3 G / 15 A / 18 P in 20 GP) is next in line. For the Rangers, Adam Fox (2 G / 21 A / 23 P in 21 GP) leads the way in scoring, with a point in eight straight games against Montréal. Alexis Lafrenière (10 G / 12 A / 22 P in 21 GP) has a team-high ten goals.
Jacob Fowler (9-1-2 / .926 SV% in 12 GS) has been terrific for Montréal and is expected to start. Joonas Korpisalo (2-0-0 / .931 SV% in 2 GS) is expected to go for the Rangers.
At home, Mike Sullivan likes to send Kartye, Miller and Dorofeyev out against the other team’s top line, so watch for them against Caufield, Suzuki and Slafkovský.

items.text: The Canadiens are newly without Chris Kreider, Josh Anderson and Mike Matheson, and have been without Ivan Demidov and Samuel Montembeault for several games. Jacob Fowler is expected to start.
Nick Suzuki has a point in six straight games against the Rangers.
The Rangers have been without Sean Durzi and Igor Shesterkin for several games. Joonas Korpisalo is expected to start.
Juraj Slafkovský has two goals on chances worth about 7.1 goals, well below what his finishing usually turns chances into. If the chances keep coming, so should the goals.
